fields.title: Blibli promo / flash sale record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Blibli's own internal API JSON. Every field Blibli returns is preserved verbatim; fields prefixed with `_` are added by this actor -- the standard envelope plus flattened headline figures (discount, prices, quota, campaign window) that a price-comparison consumer would otherwise recompute on every row. Which upstream fields are present depends on `mode`: flashSale records carry `flashsale`/`price`/`merchantCode`, promoCampaigns records carry `title`/`promoPeriod`/`categoryTree`, discountedProducts records carry the full search-result product object.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The schedule id, promo sort, or search term/category that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-flashsale-v2, S2-promotions, S3-search-discount, or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed or empty runs (BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, INVALID_INPUT, EMPTY_RESULT).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_discountPercent.title: Discount %
_discountPercent.description: Headline discount off list price, as Blibli advertises it.

_discountSource.title: Discount provenance
_discountSource.description: 'upstream' when Blibli published the discount figure itself, 'computed' when it was derived from list vs sale price because Blibli omits the field for reductions under 1%.

_contextualDiscountPercent.title: Contextual discount %
_contextualDiscountPercent.description: Discount after stacking payment-method and voucher promos on top -- usually a few points deeper than the headline figure, and the better measure of true aggressiveness. Nullable: Blibli only publishes it for some products.

_campaignName.title: Campaign name
_campaignName.description: Human-readable campaign the discount belongs to, e.g. 'Techtronic 01 - 05 September 2026'.

_savingAmount.title: Saving (IDR)
_savingAmount.description: List price minus offer price, in rupiah.

_quotaClaimedPercent.title: Flash sale quota claimed %
_quotaClaimedPercent.description: Flash Sale mode. How much of the flash-sale allocation is already gone -- the closest public proxy for sell-through speed.

_quotaStatus.title: Quota status
_quotaStatus.description: Flash Sale mode, e.g. AVAILABLE or SOLD_OUT.

_campaignCode.title: Campaign code
_campaignCode.description: Blibli campaign identifier the discount belongs to, e.g. CAMP-03285.

_isExclusive.title: Exclusive campaign
_isExclusive.description: Flash Sale mode. Whether the product sits in an exclusive branded campaign (e.g. Big Brand Day).

_scheduleId.title: Schedule id
_scheduleId.description: Flash Sale session window, formatted startEpochMs-endEpochMs.

_scheduleStart.title: Schedule start
_scheduleStart.description: UTC ISO 8601 start of the flash sale session.

_scheduleEnd.title: Schedule end
_scheduleEnd.description: UTC ISO 8601 end of the flash sale session.

_startTime.title: Promo start
_startTime.description: Promo campaign mode. UTC ISO 8601 start of the campaign.

_endTime.title: Promo end
_endTime.description: Promo campaign mode. UTC ISO 8601 end of the campaign.

_promoEndTime.title: Product promo end
_promoEndTime.description: Discounted-products mode. UTC ISO 8601 expiry of the product's promo, when Blibli exposes one.

_categoryFilter.title: Category filter
_categoryFilter.description: Flash Sale mode. The category code this record was fetched under, or null when unfiltered.

_query.title: Query
_query.description: Discounted-products mode. The search term or category code that produced this record.

_rankInQuery.title: Rank in query
_rankInQuery.description: Discounted-products mode. 1-based position in Blibli's own result ordering -- useful for tracking competitor visibility between runs.

_minDiscountFilter.title: Min discount filter
_minDiscountFilter.description: The minimum-discount threshold applied to this run.

_promoFilter.title: Promo filter
_promoFilter.description: The Blibli promo tag applied to this run, when one was set.

_productUrl.title: Product URL
_productUrl.description: Absolute blibli.com URL of the product.

_merchantUrl.title: Merchant URL
_merchantUrl.description: Absolute blibli.com URL of the seller's storefront.

_promoUrl.title: Promo URL
_promoUrl.description: Promo campaign mode. Absolute URL of the campaign landing page.
